Claude Design, 22 Nov, round 2 on the built panel (main 43e13defb). Each board puts a crop of the 22 Nov test-app shot (as built) beside the ruled version. Four open choices, the designer's pick marked “recommended”: Q1 (Context ⌘I with no chips) and Q5 (Back label) and F6 (chip anatomy) on board 3, Q2 (Wiki one-time hint) on board 4.

Confirmed without options: F1 foot inset 10/12/12 (iPad sheet 12/20/20), F2 full-width secondary New session with a boxed N cap, F3 32-pt picker header “Chat · pick a session” with the hide button last, F4 ghost ‹ ⌘[ + 1×16 vertical rule, F5 bold one-line title. Q3: icon + title · sentence · primary New session N · muted hint (no chip). Q4: one copy table (board 2).

Extra drift the designer found (E): review chip by branch name, short ages (1m), the panel opens focused on the suggestion, file chip = icon + base name, chips wrap, iPad rows use Companion status glyphs. E1 (Wiki tree moved right) is not drift: that shot used Settings › Sidebar side = right.

Rulings
  1. Q3 · order. Icon + title · sentence · primary New session N · hint. The action comes right after the sentence that explains it; the hint is a footnote.
  2. Q3 · look. The hint is muted caption text, not a chip: chips in this panel are context you can remove, and a chip that is neither clickable nor removable reads as one. It prints the key: “Closed sessions stay in Agents ⌘3”.
  3. Empty button. Primary, sized to its label (the empty node's rule), N as a boxed key cap. ⏎ also takes it: it is the only focusable thing.
  4. Header. The empty picker keeps the “Chat · pick a session” header with the hide button (F3); the shot has none.

‹file› is the file's base name (notify.go), full path in the tooltip; no line numbers in copy, since the selection moves. ‹branch› is the worktree's branch. The empty sentence is always “A new session ” + the caption with a lower-case s + “.”, so the plugin builds one string and the empty node reuses it.

Rulings
  1. F5 · title, confirmed. 13/600, one line, ellipsis at the end; the full title in the tooltip and on the picker row. Never wraps: the header stays 32.
  2. F4 · back, confirmed. Ghost button: chevron 14 + ⌘[ cap, 20 high, then a 1 × 16 vertical rule (the shot draws a long horizontal line there). Then status, title, worktree (only when not this one), hide.
  3. Q5 · no label. The tree may still send “All sessions”: the client uses it for the tooltip and the accessibility label, and draws only ‹ ⌘[.
  4. E2 · names over ids. The review chip reads “Review ‹head branch›”, never the base commit. The base, head and worktree are in the Context ⌘I detail.
  5. E5 · file chip. File icon + base name (send.go); the path in the tooltip. No “@”, no paperclip: the @ is how you add a chip, not part of it.
  6. E7 · overflow. Chips wrap to a second line inside the composer; a single chip truncates its label (middle for paths). Never past the card's edge.

Rules here

E1 tree position · Q2 where the hint sits, how it looks, when it goes.

As built · half sizedrift

The tree sits between the page and the chat.

Rulings
  1. E1 · the tree stays left. W1 replaces the margin column only. In the shot the tree jumps between the page and the chat when the panel opens; it must stay at the left edge, where ⌃⌘S hides and shows it.
  2. Q2 · the hint lives in the panel. It is drawn under the picker header the first times ⌘B opens the panel in Wiki: one muted line and a ghost “Got it”. Not on a timer.
  3. Q2 · when it goes. On Got it, or the first time ⌃⌘S is used in Wiki, or after it has shown 3 times. Then never again on this Mac.
  4. Q2 · who draws it. The client, above the SDUI tree (it is about the client's keys, not about sessions). ⏎, j/k and N still act on the list while it shows.

Rulings
  1. F1 on the sheet. Foot padding 12 top, 20 sides, 20 bottom above the sheet's edge (plus the home-indicator inset when the sheet reaches the screen's bottom).
  2. F2 on the sheet. New session is a full-width capsule (44), plain; no key cap unless a hardware keyboard is attached.
  3. F3 on the sheet. Header “Chat · pick a session” and a close button; the grabber stays.
  4. Status. Use the Companion status glyphs (one shape per status), not filled dots: a grey dot cannot say failed vs idle. The suggestion keeps its accent-tinted fill.
  5. Q4. Same copy as the Mac: “Starts on main and sees the page Checkout flow”.
